bulwark: While worn, reduces direct melee damage by 3% per total level, up to 12%.
穿戴时，直接近战伤害每总等级降低3%，最高12%。
heat_guard: While worn, reduces fire and lava damage by 4% per total level, up to 16%.
穿戴时，火焰与熔岩伤害每总等级降低4%，最高16%。
deflection: While worn, reduces projectile damage by 4% per total level, up to 16%.
穿戴时，弹射物伤害每总等级降低4%，最高16%。
anchor: While worn, grants 4% knockback resistance but reduces movement speed by 1% per total level; up to 4 levels.
穿戴时，每总等级增加4%击退抗性、降低1%移动速度；最多计4级。
lightweight: While worn, increases movement speed by 2% per total level, up to 8%.
穿戴时，移动速度每总等级增加2%，最高8%。
cushion: While worn, reduces fall damage by 6% per total level, up to 24%.
穿戴时，摔落伤害每总等级降低6%，最高24%。
last_stand: While worn below 40% health, reduces damage by 3% per total level, up to 12%.
穿戴且生命低于40%时，伤害每总等级降低3%，最高12%。
reactive: After taking direct melee damage, returns 0.5 damage per total level, up to 2; shared 1-second cooldown.
实际受到直接近战伤害后，每总等级向攻击者返还0.5点伤害，最高2点；共享1秒冷却。
venom: After taking direct melee damage, has a 15% chance per total level (up to 60%) to poison the attacker for 3 seconds; shared 4-second cooldown.
实际受到直接近战伤害后，每总等级有15%概率使攻击者中毒3秒，最高60%；共享4秒冷却。
radiant: While worn, grants night vision. It fades within 11 seconds after removal; additional levels do not stack.
穿戴时获得夜视，卸下后最多残留11秒；额外等级不叠加。
natural: While worn under an open daytime sky, repairs this piece by 1 durability per level every 5 seconds; at most 2 per piece. Broken armor cannot self-repair.
穿戴且白天露天时，每5秒每级修复本件1点耐久，单件最多2点；损坏盔甲不能自修复。
renewal: Direct melee kills against hostile mobs heal 0.5 health per total level, up to 2; shared 5-second cooldown. Reflected damage does not trigger this.
直接近战击杀敌对生物后，每总等级恢复0.5点生命，最高2点；共享5秒冷却，反伤不触发。
aquatic: While worn underwater, restores 4 air per total level each second, up to 16. Extends breathing time without granting immunity to drowning.
水下穿戴时，每秒每总等级补回4点氧气，最高16点；延长潜水时间，不能免疫溺水。
vitality: While worn, increases maximum health by 1 per total level, up to 4. Equipping does not heal.
穿戴时，每总等级增加1点生命上限，最高4点；穿戴不会直接回血。
reinforced: Increases this armor piece's durability by 10% per level, up to 20%.
本件盔甲耐久每级增加10%，最高20%。
volatile: While worn, randomly reduces each hit by 0-3% per total level, up to 0-12%.
穿戴时，每次受伤随机减免0～每总等级3%的伤害，最高0～12%。
arcane: Adds 1 upgrade slot to this armor piece per level, up to 2.
本件盔甲每级增加1个升级槽，最多2个。
composed: While worn at 90% health or more, reduces damage by 3% per total level, up to 12%.
穿戴且生命至少90%时，伤害每总等级降低3%，最高12%。
